method: Original text-only editorial illustrations of color, texture and styling. Reference URLs record the verified listings and were not image inputs.

alt.en: AI illustration of a clear glass disk on a thin ring band
alt.ja: 細いリングに透明なガラスを載せた指輪のAIイメージ

images.prompt: Square 1:1 original studio editorial still-life illustration. One understated generic silver-colored band ring with one modest transparent flat circular glass disc about 15 mm wide, atop a slender rhodium-silver-colored band. The upper glass surface is flat and polished, below it a faint matte radial accent made of soft short rays of uneven length. Avoid distinct branded design, flower precision, gemstone facets, clear prongs, faceted diamond, raised gem, or any exact identifiable real product. Use a gentle three-quarter angle at which the entire band, its circular opening and colorless disc are readable. All in frame centered on matte warm ivory card, clean soft natural shadows, no stand, no hand, no other object, logo, letters, watermark or reference images. Realistic relative proportions, understated original craft technique example.

visualReview.notes: Clear round glass and a thin band visible in both images. The matte radial marks are illustrative.

alt.en: AI illustration of an open silver-tone cuff with a hammered surface
alt.ja: 槌目の付いた開口部のある銀色のバングルのAIイメージ

images.prompt: Original square 1:1 craft-material editorial still life, AI-generated illustrative example. Exactly one narrow open-ended hammered silver cuff, an everyday 7 mm wide flat rectangular-section band curved into an oval, softly squared rounded-off ends separated with a gap, subtle irregular shallow hammer facets catching window light. Smooth edges, natural neutral silver, no stamps, inscriptions, letters, gems, engravings, extra components or boxes. Three-quarter overhead angle, whole cuff with space around it, matte warm ivory paper backdrop, subtle soft shadow. Non-branded newly designed everyday cuff, not a reproduction of a particular work, no visual inputs or product photography.

visualReview.notes: Slim open cuff and silver tone confirmed. The new hammer-mark pattern is illustrative.

alt.en: AI illustration of small green and pink enamel ornaments with pearl-shaped drops
alt.ja: 淡い緑とピンクの釉薬と丸い飾りを合わせた耳飾りのAIイメージ

images.prompt: New original square 1:1 styling illustration about pastel enamel and cotton pearls, from text only. Two tiny simple earring fronts placed flat face up on warm cream paper, both complete in front view. Absolutely no ear wires, hooks, posts, backs, clasps or long visible metal parts. Each front is a graphic, newly designed, understated round patch of pale green and pink enamel with a narrow SILVER-colored edge, and one small ivory cotton-pearl bead directly beneath joined discreetly with a tiny silver-color loop. No gold or gold-tone metal anywhere. Arrange the pieces side by side on paper in clear gentle daylight, no real product geometry or copied pattern. Soft natural shadows, plenty of quiet margin, no other props, logos, text, reference image or watermark.

visualReview.notes: Pale green and pink with a small cream drop. The solo front view avoids depicting the actual fitting.

alt.en: AI illustration of two small pink silk-thread flower studs
alt.ja: ピンクの絹糸で花を表した小さなピアスのAIイメージ

images.prompt: Original square 1:1 textile craft editorial still life. Pair of very small round pale-blush-pink textile stud earrings (about 12 mm discs) with soft matte pink silk-thread embroidery. Invent original subtle tonally shaded four petals with a few tiny thread knots at center, stitches and fine silk fibers apparent. A clean cloth edge, no crystals or sparkle, no dangling component, no exact design or brand inspiration. Both studs completely visible from the front, arranged naturally on warm off-white matte paper with clean margins, realistic soft daylight from the upper left. No props, no logos, text, watermark, visible post or exact fastening. No input images or actual photograph.

visualReview.notes: Small pink fabric fronts visible. The petal layout and sizing are illustrative.

alt.en: AI illustration of two small red lacquer studs with dark dots
alt.ja: 赤い漆と黒い点を使った小さなピアスのAIイメージ

images.prompt: Square 1:1 original still-life editorial AI illustration, an example of red lacquer on tiny wooden jewelry. A pair of simple rounded warm-red glossy lacquered dome studs about 10–15 mm, with a minimal original arrangement of a few flat black dots loosely evoking the natural appearance of a ladybug. Subdued varnish reflects soft light, no diamond or glossy gemstone, no insect head, legs, antennae, exact original design, letters, logos, branding, no copied photos or source images. Leave all edges in frame, ear studs alongside each other on quiet matte warm-white paper, natural gentle light, generous negative space.

visualReview.notes: Round red studs read clearly with abstract dark dots. The dot pattern is illustrative.
